why.title: One bot. <em3>Every</em3> superpower you need from AI.
why.sub: Other tools make you choose a model, an app, and a workflow. Miia just answers — using whatever's best, wherever you already are.

cards.title: The best model, automatically
cards.body: Miia picks GPT, Gemini, or Grok based on what you're actually asking — so you get the right brain for the job without thinking about it.

cards.title: Type, speak, snap, or drop
cards.body: Text, voice notes, photos, PDFs, links, YouTube — Miia handles every input modality Telegram supports, natively.

cards.title: Lives inside Telegram
cards.body: No new app, no separate login, no context switch. It's already in the place your messages live.

caps.title: Everything Miia <em3>can do</em3> for you.
caps.sub: A pocket-sized toolkit for thinking, making, and finding things out — built for the way you already chat.

items.title: Chat with <em1>top-tier</em1> models, no menu needed
items.body: Miia auto-routes between GPT, Gemini, and Grok based on task complexity — coding goes one way, creative writing another, reasoning another still.

items.title: Make and edit <em1>images</em1> right in the chat
items.body: Generate visuals at any resolution and aspect ratio, then edit them with plain language — no separate canvas, no upload-and-download dance.

items.title: Speak. <em1>Listen.</em1> Hands-free.
items.body: Send a voice note, hear a voice reply. Built for walks, dishes, and driving.

items.title: Read your <em1>PDFs</em1>, answer your questions
items.body: Upload docs and ask anything — Gemini file search does the heavy lifting.

items.title: Sees what you see. <em1>Reads</em1> what you send.
items.body: OCR, object recognition, and visual reasoning — drop an image and ask.

items.title: Drop a <em1>link</em1>. Get the gist.
items.body: Paste any URL or YouTube video — Miia reads it, watches it, and answers your questions about it. Great for long articles and even longer videos.

items.title: One bot, <em1>many</em1> minds
items.body: Organize conversations into separate threads with custom contexts — a coding partner, a recipe brain, a research analyst. Each remembers only what it needs to.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lede: What we collect, why, and what we never do with it.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you chat with Miia inside Telegram, the bot receives your messages and any attachments you send (images, voice notes, documents, links) so it can answer them. We store conversation history so the bot remembers context across messages.

sections.heading: What we don't do
sections.body: We never sell your chats or attachments. We don't run advertising. We don't profile you for any purpose other than running the bot.

sections.heading: Third-party AI providers
sections.body: Prompts are routed to the AI provider best suited to the task (OpenAI, Google, xAI). Those providers process the prompt under their respective terms; they do not receive your Telegram account identifiers.

sections.heading: Deletion
sections.body: You can wipe your conversation history at any time by sending /reset to the bot. Full account deletion can be requested by emailing us.

terms.title: Terms
terms.lede: The short, plain-English rules for using Miia.

sections.heading: Service description
sections.body: Miia is a Telegram bot that routes your prompts to large language models and returns their answers. Miia is provided as-is, with no service-level guarantees.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Don't use Miia to break the law, to generate content that targets or harms specific real people, or to evade the abuse controls of the underlying providers. We may rate-limit or block accounts that do.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: Outputs come from third-party AI models and may be wrong, incomplete, or out of date. Don't rely on Miia for medical, legal, or financial decisions.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms as the bot evolves. Material changes will be announced on the Telegram channel and in the changelog.

dataSecurity.title: Data & security
dataSecurity.lede: How your conversations and files are protected end-to-end.

sections.heading: Transport security
sections.body: All traffic between Telegram, Miia, and the AI providers travels over TLS. Nothing leaves your device unencrypted.

sections.heading: Storage
sections.body: Conversation history is encrypted at rest. We store only what the bot needs to keep context, and you can wipe it at any time with /reset.

sections.heading: Access
sections.body: Only the bot operator can access stored conversations, and only for the purpose of running and improving the service. We don't share access with anyone else.

sections.heading: Provider isolation
sections.body: When Miia hands your prompt to GPT, Gemini, or Grok, we strip Telegram account identifiers and send only the message text and any attachments you included.
